notes: Playing small minigames with friends is the loop, so Party & Casual leads, but the secret areas and the deliberate figure-it-out-yourself mystery are real Adventure work and that is where alcove-secret comes from. I took world-open rather than the genre's usual space-bounded because bridged islands explored in any order are a contiguous discoverable map, not one bounded room, and I emit preset none because keeping the Minigame preset would have meant swapping its staged shape and dropping all but one of its options. The author's bridged cluster is island-cluster, whose CHECK should clear since the islands sit on one plane joined by walkways rather than being layered above each other. Decided without a user: the sitting area is part of the main island's social-hub, no introduction means players spawn straight onto that hub with no tutorial space reserved, trigger-scoring gives each of the three games an end, and low lag is a build budget rather than a layout feature.
